d: Ramayana is creating massive buzz even before its release! Reports of over 1.25 lakh tickets being sold in just one hour have sparked comparisons with big-ticket films like Dhurandhar 2 and Pushpa 2. With Yash and Ranbir Kapoor leading this ambitious cinematic project, is Ramayana setting new benchmarks for advance bookings and audience excitement? Has the film managed to create a box-office frenzy even before hitting theatres? In this episode of Samosa Critics, Abhishek Manchanda discusses Ramayana's reported ticket sales, its growing hype, the comparisons with Dhurandhar 2 and Pushpa 2,…
